simple.meaning: צִנָּה (tsinnâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a hook (as pointed ); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness ); also cold (as piercing ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
